Tensor value composition, gathered input, full prologue/final output, source-admitted slice existence and whole-cell composition remain explicit.

results.evidence: Unchanged before/after content snapshot. Full integration passed 3082 exact dependency reports with only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound; 318 Lean sources checked. All 69 new explicit endpoints passed, including kernel-checked Q1--Q4 structural certificates, arbitrary-run coverage/publication, negative address/control checks and a finite 32-thread Q1 candidate witness. All 27 Python tests passed. Binding passed across 30 saved layouts: 720 contractions, 630 store blocks, 90 control skeletons and 90 complete middle slices (270 bodies), plus residual binding. Source hashes match refreshed receipts. Documentation states supported offsets, primitive source constraints, unproved tensor composition/gather/final output and source-admitted existence.
